title: Signature Duo 33 · Muscle Hourglass × USSBBW · Irezumi Cherry × Irezumi Waves · Cream Studio
prompt:
Subject: TWO Black women standing side by side, clearly separated with no overlap, a dramatic contrast of a strong muscular hourglass and extreme soft volume.

Skin: Both women have THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, their faces the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat.

Left woman — late 30s, long glossy waves with gold kanzashi combs. Muscular hourglass BBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 300 pounds — a gigantic heavy bust, broad rounded strong shoulders, enormous thick arms with big defined biceps, a clearly cinched waist that is narrow only in contrast to the enormous bust and the very wide heavy hips, a firm flat stomach with no visible abs, colossal thighs with powerful defined quads, massive calves. Feminine face, warm smile, not masculine, no bodybuilder look. Body Art: Full body Japanese irezumi body painting painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. A bright indigo and white swirling wave ground with vivid pink, vermilion, and gold cherry blossom branches, one continuous design flowing diagonally across the torso. The waves and blossoms wrap the swell of the biceps and quads and narrow across the cinched waistline. Not black shading, no dragons, no koi. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Right woman — late 30s, sleek high bun with red lacquer kanzashi. USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 800 pounds — an enormous soft apron belly hanging in several heavy overlapping rolls down to mid-thigh, deep creases between each roll, not pregnant, a gigantic bust resting on the belly, no waist at all, deep side rolls, hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso, huge thighs pressed together, enormous soft upper arms. Body Art: Full body Japanese irezumi body painting painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. A bright indigo and white ground of continuous curling white-crested waves with vermilion and gold wind bars and scattered cherry petals. The waves cover the whole body, each belly roll carrying its own curling white-crested wave, darker pigment settling into each deep crease. Not black shading, no dragons, no koi. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Pose: The left woman — standing in a glamour pose, wide stance with a strong hip shift, arms hanging relaxed slightly away from the body, no flexing. The right woman — standing full frontal in a relaxed contrapposto with her feet planted apart, her weight on one leg so that huge hip juts outward, arms held away from the body, never covering the belly.

Footwear & Nails: The left woman wears extremely high pink lacquer platform stiletto mules; the right woman wears extremely high vermilion lacquer platform stiletto mules. Extra long nails.

Background & Lighting: A seamless warm cream studio backdrop with no props, the background much lighter than their bodies, soft warm light from one side carving the inward curve of the waist and the swell of the biceps and quads on the left and deep shadows between each belly roll on the right, making the materials gleam, bright highlights on every glossy curve. 3:4 vertical 8K portrait, camera at waist height, 35mm lens.
